name: Chicken Handi
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical Indian chicken curry recipes using 1.2 kg chicken (6 adult servings).
Total time summed from explicit instruction durations (onion frying ~10 min, tomatoes ~5 min, chicken covered ~15 min) plus estimated times for remaining steps and heating (~15 min).
Yogurt and cream are dairy; recipe is otherwise gluten-free with no wheat, barley, rye or oats.
Milk allergen present due to dairy yogurt and cream; other allergens not mentioned and conservatively set per guidelines.
instructions:
Take a large pot or wok, big enough to cook all the chicken, and heat the oil in it. Once the oil is hot, add sliced onion and fry them until deep golden brown. Then take them out on a plate and set aside.
To the same pot, add the chopped garlic and sauté for a minute. Then add the chopped tomatoes and cook until tomatoes turn soft. This would take about 5 minutes.
Then return the fried onion to the pot and stir. Add ginger paste and sauté well.
Now add the cumin seeds, half of the coriander seeds and chopped green chillies. Give them a quick stir.
Next goes in the spices – turmeric powder and red chilli powder. Sauté the spices well for couple of minutes.
Add the chicken pieces to the wok, season it with salt to taste and cook the chicken covered on medium-low heat until the chicken is almost cooked through. This would take about 15 minutes. Slowly sautéing the chicken will enhance the flavor, so do not expedite this step by putting it on high heat.
When the oil separates from the spices, add the beaten yogurt keeping the heat on lowest so that the yogurt doesn’t split. Sprinkle the remaining coriander seeds and add half of the dried fenugreek leaves. Mix well.
Finally add the cream and give a final mix to combine everything well.
Sprinkle the remaining kasuri methi and garam masala and serve the chicken handi hot with naan or rotis. Enjoy!

ingredients.name: Chicken
ingredients.assumptions: Raw chicken with skin and bone, typical broiler chicken nutrient profile; entire 1.2 kg line used as given.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 5 medium-large onions at ~125 g each after peeling; typical raw yellow onion values.

ingredients.name: Tomatoes
ingredients.assumptions: 2 large tomatoes at ~150 g each; typical raw red tomato values, chopped.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 8 average garlic cloves (~3 g each); typical raw garlic cloves, chopped.

ingredients.name: Ginger paste
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbsp ginger paste ≈ 15 g; values based on typical fresh ginger root paste.

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.assumptions: ¼ cup vegetable oil ≈ 55 g (density ~0.92 g/ml); typical neutral vegetable oil.

ingredients.name: Cumin seeds
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tsp cumin seeds ≈ 4 g; typical whole cumin seed values.

ingredients.name: Coriander seeds
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tsp coriander seeds ≈ 6 g; typical whole coriander seed values; split use in recipe but full amount estimated here.

ingredients.name: Turmeric powder
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp turmeric powder ≈ 2 g; typical ground turmeric values.

ingredients.name: Chilli powder
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp red chilli powder ≈ 2 g; typical ground red chili powder values.

ingredients.name: Green chilli
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium green chillies ≈ 15 g each; typical raw green chili pepper values.

ingredients.name: Yogurt
ingredients.assumptions: 1 cup plain yogurt ≈ 245 g; typical full-fat unsweetened yogurt, beaten.

ingredients.name: Cream
ingredients.assumptions: ¾ cup heavy cream ≈ 180 g (density ~1.0 g/ml); typical heavy whipping cream values.

ingredients.name: fenugreek
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tsp dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi) ≈ 6 g; typical dried leaf values, full amount for entire line.

ingredients.name: Garam masala
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp garam masala ≈ 2 g; typical powdered spice blend values.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.assumptions: Salt to taste estimated at 6 g (≈1 tsp) for whole recipe; sodium not in macros, all other nutrients zero.
